message: HOLD — 3 critical error(s) found. Correct before shipping.

critical_errors.description: The FCRA disclosure must be a clear, standalone document — not combined with the employment application or other paperwork. Bundled disclosures = FCRA violation.
critical_errors.check: Disclosure provided as STANDALONE document (not buried in application)
critical_errors.notes: Disclosure was page 3 of the employment application, not standalone

critical_errors.description: 70% of organizations fail this step. Before taking adverse action, employer MUST send: (1) copy of the background report, (2) A Summary of Your Rights Under the FCRA. Then WAIT at least 5 business days.
critical_errors.check: Pre-Adverse Action Notice sent BEFORE final decision (with report copy + FCRA rights summary)
critical_errors.notes: No pre-adverse notice sent; went straight to rejection

critical_errors.description: After sending pre-adverse notice, employer must wait at least 5 business days before making final adverse decision. Rushing this timeline = FCRA violation.
critical_errors.check: Minimum 5 business day waiting period observed between pre-adverse and final notice
critical_errors.notes: Adverse decision made same day as report
